summary: For Bangkok's best-known kai jeow pu (ไข่เจียวปู), Jay Fai in Phra Nakhon serves a crisp, golden crab omelette cooked over charcoal. It is an expensive, queue-prone meal at a compact street-side shophouse; treat it as a destination meal, not a quick market snack.
whyGo: The omelette combines a crisp exterior with generous sweet crab, and MICHELIN calls it the signature dish.
Jay Fai's open charcoal kitchen and street-side setting make the meal part of the experience.
The Maha Chai Road address is near Old Town sights including Loha Prasat, so it can fit a Phra Nakhon day.
bestFor: Crab and egg fans willing to spend substantially more than at an ordinary street-food stall
Visitors who value the iconic chef and cooking setting as much as the dish
A flexible Old Town meal when a long wait will not disrupt the rest of the day
skipIf: You have a crab, shellfish or egg allergy, or need reliable allergen separation
You are on a tight budget, schedule or need a quick meal
You need confirmed step-free access, spacious seating or a quiet indoor dining room
duration: Allow 1–3 hours for the queue, ordering and meal; this is a planning estimate and waits vary considerably.
cost: MICHELIN currently places Jay Fai in its ฿฿฿ band but does not publish dish prices. Thai PBS reported in August 2025 that the menu-listed crab omelette was THB 1,500 and a separately prepared special was THB 4,000. Prices may have changed: check the displayed menu and confirm the price for your exact order before it is cooked. Bring cash; MICHELIN lists cash only.
hours: MICHELIN's listing checked 17 October 2026 says Wednesday–Saturday, 09:00–19:30, closed Sunday–Tuesday. Other tourism listings show conflicting schedules; verify directly near your visit, including December holiday dates.
bestTime: If relying on a walk-in, arrive before opening and allow a flexible morning or lunch window; MICHELIN warns that queuing and standing are part of the visit. Avoid fitting it between timed attractions.
gettingThere: The restaurant is at 327 Maha Chai Road, Samran Rat, Phra Nakhon. The Tourism Authority of Thailand identifies MRT Sam Yot as the nearest station; continue on foot or by taxi using a live map. Allow time for the final walk in Old Town traffic.
booking: MICHELIN lists phone +66 2 223 9384 but does not describe a reservation system. Contact the restaurant to confirm current booking or queue arrangements and hours; do not assume an online booking slot is available. The listing says cash only.
accessibility: The sources reviewed do not confirm step-free entry, accessible toilets, seating layout or queue accommodations. The small street-side setting and reported standing queue may be difficult for some visitors; contact the restaurant before travelling if access is a concern.
practicalTips: Ask the staff to show you the current menu price for the crab omelette and confirm any special preparation price before ordering.
Bring enough cash; card acceptance is not listed by MICHELIN.
The omelette is rich and filling. Check portion size and consider sharing if the restaurant allows it.
Ask directly about crab, shellfish, egg, sauces and cross-contact; allergy controls were not verified.
Eat there if possible: a crisp omelette will soften during a long takeaway journey.
decemberNotes: Kai jeow pu is available year-round, and no special December 2026 service or event was found. December is a busy visitor month; reconfirm hours and queue arrangements shortly before going, especially around public holidays and New Year.
uncertainties: Published weekly hours conflict between sources and may change before December 2026.
The current menu price and whether premium crab options are offered were not confirmed directly; the THB 1,500 and THB 4,000 figures come from an August 2025 news report.
Reservation or queue procedures, wait duration, payment beyond cash-only listing, and detailed accessibility were not confirmed directly.
